overview_description.description: Midl is a Bitcoin-native infrastructure project that enables developers to build and run decentralized applications (dApps) directly on the Bitcoin network. It provides an EVM-compatible execution layer, allowing smart contracts, DeFi apps, and tokens without bridges or wrapped assets. The platform focuses on scalability, faster confirmations, and seamless Bitcoin wallet integration.

product.name: MIDL Bitcoin Abstraction Layer
product.description: A Bitcoin abstraction layer enabling native execution of Ethereum-compatible decentralized applications directly on the Bitcoin network without asset bridging.

product.name: MIDL Devnet
product.description: A public development network providing early access to test and build native Bitcoin dApps using MIDL's infrastructure.

product.name: MIDL Swap
product.description: A decentralized exchange service enabling trading of runes and ordinals on the Bitcoin network through MIDL's platform.

product.name: MIDL Native BTC Stablecoin Issuance
product.description: A service to mint stablecoin assets natively backed by Bitcoin on the MIDL platform.

product.name: MIDL Lending Platform
product.description: A platform for borrowing and lending Bitcoin-native assets using MIDL's infrastructure on the Bitcoin network.
